Offzone uses Android Accessibility to detect which app opens and place a pause screen over the apps you select, only during a focus session you start. It uses app package names, not screen contents or typed text. Your selection stays on this device and is not sent or shared. You can restore access for free or turn the service off in Android settings at any time. On the next screen, select Offzone and turn on the service.
Pauses your selected apps during focus sessions you start. Uses app names only; does not read screen contents. Free restore is always available.
On this device.\nAlways free to stop.

Offzone uses precise location to confirm you are inside your chosen place and restore access when you leave or your location cannot be confirmed. After you start place focus or monitoring, checks continue even when Offzone is not visible. An ongoing notification shows monitoring and lets you restore access and stop it for free. Arrival never starts blocking automatically. Location fixes stay on this device and are not sent to Offzone. The optional map is separate and sends the viewed area and your IP address to OpenStreetMap only when you choose Show map.
